title: Loss Location via CWB MFE
walkthroughSteps: Apply an AC — banner seeds the FNOL policy state and CWB seed data
Land on /fnol/loss-information; the wizard must already be past the search step
Open the 'Locations of loss' card → click 'Add location' to enter the adding state
Pick the 'Retrieve from CWB' radio → 'Search in CWB' button appears
Click 'Search in CWB' → external-system modal opens with 7 search fields
Verify Policy Number and Location Rule Number are pre-filled and read-only
Pick Country (mandatory) → Search enables → fill optional filters → results table populates
Pick a row (radio) → 'Confirm selection' → modal closes; selected card shows source 'From CWB'

acceptanceCriteria.statement: User has the option to retrieve a loss location from CWB
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: On `/fnol/loss-information`, after clicking **Add location**, the user sees a third radio option: *Retrieve from CWB*. Available alongside `Find in policy` and `Enter manually`.

setup.description: Seed FNOL policy so the user lands directly on Loss Information

preconditions.text: FNOL is past search — selected policy POL-2024-001
Add location → see three radio options including 'Retrieve from CWB'

expectedUI.description: Third radio option visible after Add location
visualCues: Three radios stacked: Find in policy / Retrieve from CWB / Enter manually
Each radio has a subtitle describing the mode
CWB radio subtitle mentions 'Commercial Work Bench'

howToTest.trigger: Click 'Add location' in the Locations of loss card
howToTest.expectedResult: Three radio modes visible — including 'Retrieve from CWB'

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Clicking 'Retrieve from CWB' opens the external-system modal (MFE)
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Selecting **Retrieve from CWB** + clicking *Search in CWB* opens a modal labelled *Commercial Work Bench (CWB)* with an `External system` badge — visually signalling an external lookup.

setup.description: Same as AC-01 — seed CWB has 6 records under POL-2024-001 already

preconditions.text: Modal opens with header 'Commercial Work Bench (CWB) — Location search'
An 'External system' badge is visible in the header

expectedUI.description: Modal styled to indicate external system
visualCues: Header reads 'Commercial Work Bench (CWB) — Location search'
External system badge with link icon visible
Subtitle: 'Retrieve a property record from CWB and link it to the loss.'

howToTest.trigger: Add location → choose 'Retrieve from CWB' radio → click 'Search in CWB'
howToTest.expectedResult: Modal opens with CWB header and external-system badge

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Modal exposes the required search params per spec
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: The CWB modal exposes **7 search params**: *Policy number* (read-only), *Location rule number* (read-only), `Country`, `City`, `ZIP / postal code`, `Street and number`, `Geo-coordinates`. Read-only fields are pre-filled from the policy mapping.

setup.description: Same setup as AC-01 — opens modal with pre-filled values

preconditions.text: Country / City / ZIP / Street / Geo-coordinates are editable

expectedUI.description: Form layout: 3-column grid with read-only and editable fields
visualCues: Policy number input is disabled with hint 'Pre-filled from selected policy (read-only)'
Location rule number input is disabled with hint 'Derived from policy mapping (read-only)'
Country dropdown is required (asterisk in label)
City / ZIP / Street and number / Geo-coordinates inputs editable

howToTest.expectedResult: All 7 fields visible with correct edit-state

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Mandatory-field validation on Policy / Rule / Country
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: **Search** is `disabled` until *Policy*, *Rule*, and *Country* are populated. With Policy and Rule pre-filled, the user must select a Country before search becomes enabled. Field error appears on Country if user submits while empty.

setup.description: Open modal — Country is the only blank required field

preconditions.text: On modal open, Search button is disabled (Country empty)
After picking any Country, Search becomes enabled
Clicking Search with Country empty surfaces the error 'Country is required.'

visualCues: Search button disabled when Country empty
Validation hint appears when user attempts search with Country empty
Optional fields (City, ZIP, Street, Geo-coords) never block search

howToTest.trigger: Open CWB modal, leave Country empty → attempt search
howToTest.expectedResult: Search remains disabled; error appears under Country if forced

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Selection persists into the Loss Location form
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Picking a CWB result and clicking **Confirm selection** *closes* the modal and adds the result as a *Loss Location* card in the picker — labelled **From CWB** with the address, postal code, city and country mapped from the CWB row.

setup.description: Seed bundled CWB cache already contains 6 records for POL-2024-001 (DE rows)

preconditions.text: Pick Country = DE → Search → 5 results returned
Modal closes; the selected location appears as a card with 'From CWB' label
The CWB reference appears in the property-id slot of the card

expectedUI.description: After confirm, picker enters 'selected' state with one CWB-sourced card
visualCues: Card shows location name (e.g. 'Liver Tea Group — Munich HQ')
Card shows full address line + postal + city + country

howToTest.trigger: Open CWB modal → Country=DE → Search → pick CWB-LOC-001 → Confirm
howToTest.expectedResult: Modal closes; 'Liver Tea Group — Munich HQ' card appears with 'From CWB' label
